in: LocalSeatCredentialRepository: get, provision (upsert clears revocation and lockout), revoke (keeps the counter and lock), recordFailure (generation-fenced, durable, locks at the threshold), clearFailures (generation-fenced); every write one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction doing operation-id replay or refusal, generation CAS and the operation record

LocalSeatCredentialService operator half: LOCAL_SEAT_POLICY (all Root-recommended numbers bound), error taxonomy with codes only, AttemptWindow, listSeats, provision, revoke, route-wide operator window before the primary-password KDF, real primary vault verification without switching the active row, non-secret fingerprint

local-seats API route, request schemas, Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site guard, no-store header (LSC-1)

carryIn.CF-LSC0-8: Revoke keeps failed_attempts and locked_until_ms; re-provision clears both and revocation; recordFailure and clearFailures are fenced by generation (a mint that began before a re-provision cannot touch the new seat). Rows in both suites.
carryIn.CF-LSC0-15: LOCAL_SEAT_POLICY binds 10 mint and 5 operator attempts per 60 s window, lockout after 5 failures for 60 s, seat token default and cap 1 h; a test asserts the exact numbers. The operator window is exercised here; the mint window is exercised by LSC-1.
carryIn.CF-LSC0-16: Persistence and repository semantics: only success or re-provision clears the count, so after a lock expires the next failure re-locks at once (stated in the repository and tested). The operator window counts every operator write attempt (including denied, throttled-adjacent and duplicate deliveries) before key derivation and resets 60 s after its first attempt. Whether locked-seat and second-concurrent-mint refusals consume the mint window is LSC-1.
carryIn.CF-LSC0-17: A duplicate delivery passes the operator window and the primary-password check before the repository replays the recorded outcome; a duplicate with a wrong operator password is refused, and a duplicate with a different seat password keeps the originally applied key (tested).
carryIn.CF-LSC0-6 (routed share): Errors carry codes and numeric detail only; operation fingerprints hash non-secret parameters; no console or logger call carries a password (spied); seat rows hold only the ciphertext envelope. Request-scoped key lifetime is LSC-1 (mint).
carryIn.window: Route-wide, process-local, never keyed by client address or forwarded header (the service API takes no address).
carryIn.CF-LSC1DB-1: Bind integer generation/counter/deadline values; SQL compare-and-set requires changes === 1; stale expected generation leaves row and operation history unchanged; revoke keeps lock/counter and re-provision clears both.
carryIn.CF-LSC1DB-2: One operation per seat/result generation is now schema-enforced. Test competing writers and lost-CAS rollback with no recorded losing outcome.
carryIn.CF-LSC1DB-3: Revoked means revoked_at IS NOT NULL. Compare deadlines with the same injected wall clock used to write; clock rollback preserves a future lock, and forward jumps may shorten it.
carryIn.CF-LSC1DB-4: Operator unlocked/generated private keys stay request-local, generated mutable key bytes cleared in finally. Only encrypted envelope persisted. Logs/errors/outcomes/operation rows expose no passwords or raw key data, including exceptional dependency paths. Mint-specific key lifetime remains LSC-1.
carryIn.CF-LSC1DB-5: Only successful authentication or re-provision clears the failure count. Operator window consumes duplicate, denied, stale and failed attempts before KDF; first-attempt anchored fixed windows. Mint-specific locked/concurrent refusal consumption remains LSC-1.
